init_config: initialize the Mephisto YAML config file at ~/.mephisto/config.yml with a default core section
get_config: get the full Mephisto configuration dictionary by parsing the YAML config file
write_config: write a dictionary of configuration data to the Mephisto YAML config file
add_config_arg: add or overwrite a key-value pair in a named section of the Mephisto config file
get_config_arg: get a specific configuration value from a named section of the Mephisto config file
